text: People ask me if I regret it, and the honest answer is that I regret the first eight months and nothing after that. If you move, the first winter is the test. Not the cold. The silence. Nobody calls you, because nobody knows you yet, and you have not built the kind of friendship where somebody calls. What nobody told me is this. If you wait for people to come to you, you will be alone for two years. If you make yourself the one who invites, it takes about six months. That is the whole difference. The visa was the easy part. The paperwork was the easy part. The hard part was learning to say yes to things I did not want to do, on a Tuesday, when I was tired, because that is where the people are. If I could send one message back to myself, it would not be about money and it would not be about the job. It would be four words. Go to the thing.

I lasted fourteen months, and I want to be careful how I say this, because people hear it as a failure story and it is not. I loved it. The apartment was better than anything I will ever afford here. The food, obviously. What got me was something smaller. Every conversation I had was a beginner conversation. I am a funny person in English. In the other language I was a polite person, which is a different person. And after a year of being the polite version of myself, I missed being the funny one. So if you are thinking about it, here is my actual advice. Do not ask yourself whether you can survive there. You can. Ask yourself how long you can go without being fully yourself, because that is the clock that runs out first. For some people it never runs out. For me it was fourteen months, and I would do it again tomorrow.
If I get the offer, I will take it.
If the rent is too high, we will look into another neighborhood.
We will settle down there if we can make a living.
If we do not find a neighborhood we like, we will wait a year.
What will you do if the application takes two years?
If I go alone first, I might stay three months.
If I go alone first, I might stay three months and see how I fit in.
